brief:
The National Guidance and Moral Orientation Authority and al-Bireh Municipality organized a Palestinian flag-raising ceremony aimed at strengthening national belonging, the Ma'an news agency reported. The event served as a show of patriotic commitment amid ongoing tensions in the occupied territories.

Officials and residents participated in the flag-hoisting activity, which the organizing bodies framed as reinforcing Palestinian identity and connection to national symbols during a period of political and security challenges.
title: Ramallah and al-Bireh raise Palestinian flag in nationalist ceremony
